slots.title: Kawat Duri Ditarik Kencang Duri Tetap Terkunci
slots.hook: Kawat duri ditarik kuat dengan tang di antara dua patok, duri tetap terkunci dan lapisan seng tidak mengelupas
slots.story: Di batas kebun sawit, dua patok kayu tua sudah berdiri dengan satu helai kawat duri terentang. Sejak detik nol, satu roll Kawat Duri Diamond resmi bersandar di patok kiri dengan label oval dan cap DIAMOND menghadap kamera. Pekerja sudah mencengkeram kawat dengan tang, menariknya kencang ke arah dada sampai kawat lurus dan bergetar, sementara mata duri tetap terkunci rapat di pilinan. Ia mengusap permukaan kawat dengan sarung tangan dan tidak ada serpihan seng yang menempel. Penutup: ia menoleh ke lensa dan menyebut produk serta perusahaan, lalu mengarahkan penonton bertanya ukuran lewat DM tanpa nomor WhatsApp.
slots.caption:
Kawat duri ditarik kencang di antara dua patok dan mata durinya tetap terkunci rapat tanpa ada serpihan seng yang mengelupas. Mau tahu ukuran yang pas untuk pagar kebun? Tanya lewat DM.

shots.dialogue: Ditarik kencang durinya tidak lepas. Kawat Duri Diamond PT Intan Suar Kartika kuat.
shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, one continuous take, shot on smartphone vlog camera held at chest height with gentle natural handheld sway and a slight three-quarter angle along a barbed wire fence line, natural clean daylight neutral white balance, true-to-life colors, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores, no plastic shine, no waxy skin, no glass skin, no yellow or orange tint, no artificial golden glow, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look, clean frame without camera HUD, no REC icon, no viewfinder brackets, no camera display overlay, no on-screen text or captions of any kind. Location: the edge of a palm oil smallholding in North Sumatra, two weathered wooden fence posts about three metres apart, reddish soil and grass, blurred oil palms behind, bright overcast midday sky. From the very first frame one upright roll of galvanised barbed wire from the single attached official reference photo leans against the left post, its tight shiny silver coil and oval label with the red gear mark and the DIAMOND mark facing the camera. An Indonesian male construction worker about 38 years old in a faded dusty blue long-sleeve work shirt, dark work trousers, grey cotton work gloves and a brown field cap stands at the right post; his face, gloved hands and torso stay in frame the whole take. PROP CONTINUITY RULE: from 0.0s to 10.0s exactly one upright wire roll leaning on the left post, one pair of pliers in his right hand, one barbed wire strand already strung between the two posts and nothing else are the props; no vehicle, animal, bucket, hammer, machete, extra person, extra roll or extra tool may appear, move in, fall or disappear at any instant, the coil shape and wire thickness must not change, and the wire strand must never snap. BEATS: at 0.0s he already grips the wire strand with the pliers and pulls it hard toward his chest, the wire straightens and vibrates while every barb stays locked in its twisted knot; from 3.0s to 6.0s he keeps the wire taut with one hand and runs his gloved palm along it, the galvanised surface matte silver with no flakes sticking to the glove; from 6.0s to 8.0s he gives the strand one more firm pull, the posts stay planted and the barbs do not slip; from 8.0s to 10.0s he looks straight into the lens and says in clear Indonesian: "Ditarik kencang durinya tidak lepas. Kawat Duri Diamond PT Intan Suar Kartika kuat." Natural site ambience only, light wind, distant birds, no music. Keep his face, clothing, cap, gloves, post positions and background consistent in every frame.

trend_sources.title: Spesifikasi Kawat Duri Galvanis: Electro vs Hot Dip
trend_sources.evidence: Dibaca 27 November 2026 pukul 10.05 WIB: kawat duri galvanis electro memiliki ketebalan zinc sekitar 10 sampai 15 gram per meter persegi, sedangkan hot dip galvanized 40 sampai 60 gram per meter persegi dan bisa lebih dari 200 gram untuk heavy galvanized; kuat tarik 350 sampai 500 N/mm2. Dipakai sebagai dasar bahwa lapisan seng tipis lebih cepat kehilangan perlindungan, dan klaim ketahanan dibatasi pada apa yang terlihat di klip.

trend_sources.title: Cara Memilih Antara Kawat Baja Galvanis dan Kawat Baja Tahan Karat
trend_sources.evidence: Dibaca 27 November 2026 pukul 10.07 WIB: kawat galvanis dibuat dari baja karbon yang ditarik menjadi kawat lalu digalvanisasi celup panas atau elektro untuk membentuk lapisan seng pelindung di permukaan yang mencegah karat. Dipakai sebagai konteks mengapa kondisi lapisan seng layak diperiksa saat kawat ditarik dan dipakai di luar ruangan.

slots.source_note: Video tidak menyebut harga, angka penjualan, uji laboratorium, atau merek pesaing. Sumber hanya dipakai untuk konteks ketebalan lapisan seng dan fungsi galvanisasi. Klaim ketahanan dibatasi pada apa yang benar-benar terlihat di klip. Tidak ada nomor WhatsApp di caption maupun naskah; ajakan diarahkan halus ke DM.
